asks.message: CBTRN02C validates over-limit (102) then expiry (103) without stopping: a transaction that is both over limit and past expiry is rejected as 103 only, so the 102 reason is silently lost in DALYREJS
asks.request: Business owner: should the reject carry the first failing rule (102) or the last (103)? The modernized job reproduces 103 for parity until decided

notes.text: POSTTRAN is the daily posting step: DALYTRAN is validated against CARDXREF and ACCTDATA; good items are written to TRANSACT and update ACCTDATA and TCATBALF, bad items go to the DALYREJS(+1) generation
Reject reasons are numeric codes 100 (invalid card), 101 (account not found), 102 (over limit), 103 (after account expiry), 109 (balance-category rewrite failure)

asks.message: CBACT04C falls back to the DEFAULT disclosure group on status 23, but abends (9999-ABEND-PROGRAM) if the DEFAULT row is itself missing for that transaction type/category, stopping the monthly interest run
asks.request: Operations: is a DEFAULT disclosure-group row guaranteed for every type/category? If not, the abend is a latent production risk

notes.text: The monthly chain closes the CICS files, runs INTCALC (CBACT04C, PARM run date), merges system transactions into TRANSACT with COMBTRAN (SORT + REPRO), then reopens the files
Tech debt: the DISCGRP open-failure path displays 'ERROR OPENING DALY REJECTS FILE' (copy-paste message), misleading operators during an incident
